fix_consequence.capable_model: Uses a different model that supports this task; results may differ from your usual model.
fix_consequence.continue_anyway: Keeps going, but noticeably slower than usual.
fix_consequence.continue_unverified: The file's integrity cannot be checked; continue only if you trust this source.
fix_consequence.cpu: Runs on the CPU: much slower, but independent of the GPU driver.
fix_consequence.cpu_build: Uses the CPU build of the runtime: slower until the pack is repaired.
fix_consequence.cpu_combo: Runs entirely on the CPU with smaller models: slower and slightly less accurate.
fix_consequence.cpu_ep: Uses the CPU instead: search vectors and face detection are slower.
fix_consequence.force_rerun: Runs inference again on photos that already have results; uses GPU time.
fix_consequence.installed_q4: Uses the smaller variant you already have: slightly lower accuracy.
fix_consequence.keep_skipping: Videos and RAW files that need ffmpeg stay skipped.
fix_consequence.llamacpp: Uses llama.cpp instead: broader hardware support, possibly slower.
fix_consequence.llamacpp_vulkan: Uses llama.cpp with Vulkan: works on this GPU, usually slower than the native runtime.
fix_consequence.local_model: Runs on this workspace's own worker; nothing is sent to the external service.
fix_consequence.lower_resolution: Analyses smaller copies of the photos: less detail in captions and tags.
fix_consequence.other_variant: Uses another variant of the model: speed and accuracy may differ.
fix_consequence.q4_k_m: Uses the Q4_K_M variant: fits in less VRAM, slightly lower accuracy.
fix_consequence.queue_after: Starts when the running job finishes.
fix_consequence.reapply_thresholds: Re-applies the new thresholds to existing results without running inference again.
fix_consequence.skip_conflicts: Files changed since organizing stay where they are; everything else is undone.
fix_consequence.smaller_model: Uses a smaller model: needs less memory, slightly lower accuracy.
fix_consequence.smaller_variant: Uses a smaller variant: less space and memory, slightly lower accuracy.
fix_consequence.t256_only: Keeps only the smallest thumbnails: less detail in the viewer until there is space.
fix_consequence.vulkan: Uses the Vulkan runtime: works with this driver, may be slower.
